newsitem.title: FINLAND: ICE HOCKEY-DUBE HELPS FRANCE TO FIRST WIN.
newsitem.headline: ICE HOCKEY-DUBE HELPS FRANCE TO FIRST WIN.

text.p: Roger Dube scored both goals as France beat Germany 2-1 in the ice hockey world championship on Friday.
Dube almost completed a hat-trick late in a match between two pool A teams who had not collected a point between them in their three opening games.

With just 45 seconds on the clock and goaltender Olaf Kolzig off the ice as Germany battled for an equaliser with an extra outfield player, Dube snatched the puck and shot from the blue line towards the empty German goal.
But to his dismay the puck hit first the left, then the right post and failed to cross the red goal line.

With France in power-play Dube gave them the lead in the fourth minute, finding an opening between Kolzig's legs. Dube added his second -- again between the German netminder's legs -- in the 36th minute.
Germany dominated for much of the second and third periods, Francois Gravel in the French goal making 30 saves against 22 for Kolzig.
But Gravel was beaten only once, by Marco Sturm in the 43rd minute.
